// Exact TLS forwarding at the immutable selected Origin, with one reply loss.
package main
import (
 "bytes"
 "context"
 "crypto/tls"
 "crypto/x509"
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "io"
 "net"
 "net/http"
 "net/url"
 "path/filepath"
 "sync"
 "time"
 "github.com/taytr-llc/slug/poolservice"
)
type issueWireEvent struct { RequestID string `json:"request_id"`;Path string `json:"path"`;AtMS int64 `json:"at_ms"`;Forwarded bool `json:"forwarded"`;Status int `json:"status"`;SHA256 string `json:"response_sha256"`;Lost bool `json:"lost"` }
type issueTLSRelay struct {
 server *http.Server;listener net.Listener;client *http.Client;done chan error
 mu sync.Mutex;active sync.WaitGroup;closing bool;failure error
 expected poolservice.RecoverableDailySelection;originalID string;lose,held,lost bool
 lostResult poolservice.IssueResponse;lostRaw []byte;loss chan struct{};release chan struct{}
 events []issueWireEvent
 replay chan poolservice.IssueResponse;replayed bool
}
func publicSelection(c poolservice.RecoverableDailyClientConfig) poolservice.RecoverableDailySelection {
 b,e:=poolservice.DailyTransportTrustID(c.Base);check(e,"base TLS trust");id,e:=poolservice.RecoverableDailyTransportTrustID(c);check(e,"issue TLS trust")
 return poolservice.RecoverableDailySelection{Version:1,BaseVersion:2,URL:c.Base.URL,PublicKey:c.Base.PublicKey,Source:c.Base.Source,IssueProfile:c.IssueProfile,SettlementConfigID:c.Base.SettlementConfigID,RecipientScript:c.Base.RecipientScript,BaseTransportTrustID:b,TransportTrustID:id}
}
func startIssueTLS(ctx context.Context,private,backend string,c poolservice.RecoverableDailyClientConfig) *issueTLSRelay {
 selected,e:=url.Parse(c.Base.URL);check(e,"selected TLS URL");cert,e:=tls.LoadX509KeyPair(filepath.Join(private,"tls-cert.pem"),filepath.Join(private,"tls-key.pem"));check(e,"original TLS keypair")
 roots:=x509.NewCertPool();require(roots.AppendCertsFromPEM([]byte(c.Base.CACertificate)),"original selected CA")
 l,e:=net.Listen("tcp4",selected.Host);check(e,"selected external Origin listener")
 tr:=&http.Transport{Proxy:nil,DisableCompression:true,DisableKeepAlives:true,MaxResponseHeaderBytes:65536,TLSClientConfig:&tls.Config{MinVersion:tls.VersionTLS13,MaxVersion:tls.VersionTLS13,RootCAs:roots,ServerName:selected.Hostname()}}
 r:=&issueTLSRelay{listener:tls.NewListener(l,&tls.Config{MinVersion:tls.VersionTLS13,MaxVersion:tls.VersionTLS13,Certificates:[]tls.Certificate{cert},NextProtos:[]string{"http/1.1"}}),client:&http.Client{Timeout:30*time.Second,Transport:tr,CheckRedirect:func(*http.Request,[]*http.Request)error{return http.ErrUseLastResponse}},done:make(chan error,1),expected:publicSelection(c),loss:make(chan struct{}),release:make(chan struct{}),replay:make(chan poolservice.IssueResponse,1)}
 r.server=&http.Server{ReadHeaderTimeout:5*time.Second,ReadTimeout:10*time.Second,WriteTimeout:35*time.Second,MaxHeaderBytes:16384,BaseContext:func(net.Listener)context.Context{return ctx}}
 r.server.Handler=http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter,q *http.Request){
  r.mu.Lock();if r.closing {r.mu.Unlock();http.Error(w,"closed",503);return};r.active.Add(1);r.mu.Unlock();defer r.active.Done()
  if q.Host!=selected.Host || q.URL.RawQuery!="" || q.URL.Fragment!="" {http.Error(w,"origin",400);return}
  raw,e:=io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(q.Body,poolservice.MaxWorkResponseSize+1));if e!=nil || len(raw)>poolservice.MaxWorkResponseSize {http.Error(w,"bound",400);return}
  issue:=q.URL.Path=="/pool/v3/issue";lookup:=q.URL.Path=="/pool/v3/issue-lookup"
  id:="";index:=-1
  if issue || lookup {var v poolservice.IssueRequest;d:=json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw));d.DisallowUnknownFields();if d.Decode(&v)!=nil || len(v.RequestID)!=64 {http.Error(w,"request",400);return};canonical,_:=json.Marshal(v);if !bytes.Equal(bytes.Trim(raw," \t\r\n"),canonical){http.Error(w,"canonical request",400);return};id=v.RequestID
   r.mu.Lock();if len(r.events)>=128 {r.failure=errors.Join(r.failure,errors.New("issue event bound"));r.mu.Unlock();http.Error(w,"bound",503);return};if issue && r.originalID=="" {r.originalID=id};blocked:=issue && r.held;index=len(r.events);r.events=append(r.events,issueWireEvent{RequestID:id,Path:q.URL.Path,AtMS:time.Now().UnixMilli()});r.mu.Unlock()
   if blocked {select{case <-q.Context().Done():return;case <-r.release:};if q.Context().Err()!=nil{return}}
  }
  up,e:=http.NewRequestWithContext(q.Context(),q.Method,"https://"+backend+q.URL.EscapedPath(),bytes.NewReader(raw));if e!=nil {http.Error(w,"request",502);return};up.Host=selected.Host;up.Header=q.Header.Clone();up.Header.Del("Connection");up.Header.Del("Proxy-Authorization")
  if index>=0 {r.mu.Lock();r.events[index].Forwarded=true;r.mu.Unlock()}
  response,e:=r.client.Do(up);if e!=nil {http.Error(w,"upstream",502);return};body,e:=io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body,poolservice.MaxWorkResponseSize+1));ce:=response.Body.Close();if e!=nil || ce!=nil || len(body)>poolservice.MaxWorkResponseSize {http.Error(w,"response",502);return}
  if index>=0 {r.mu.Lock();r.events[index].Status=response.StatusCode;r.events[index].SHA256=hx(digest(body));drop:=issue && r.lose && !r.lost && id==r.originalID && response.StatusCode==http.StatusOK;r.mu.Unlock()
   if drop {var value poolservice.IssueResponse;d:=json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body));d.DisallowUnknownFields();e=d.Decode(&value);canonical,_:=json.Marshal(value)
    if e!=nil || !bytes.Equal(bytes.Trim(body," \t\r\n"),canonical) || poolservice.ValidateRecoverableIssueResponse(r.expected,id,value,false)!=nil || value.Result.State!="work" {r.mu.Lock();r.failure=errors.Join(r.failure,errors.New("loss did not capture exact selected work"));r.mu.Unlock();http.Error(w,"invalid selected response",502);return}
    h,ok:=w.(http.Hijacker);if !ok {r.mu.Lock();r.failure=errors.Join(r.failure,errors.New("missing original TLS hijacker"));r.mu.Unlock();return};conn,_,e:=h.Hijack();if e!=nil {r.mu.Lock();r.failure=errors.Join(r.failure,e);r.mu.Unlock();return}
    r.mu.Lock();r.lost=true;r.held=true;r.lostResult=value;r.lostRaw=append([]byte{},body...);r.events[index].Lost=true;r.mu.Unlock()
    // No response headers or bytes have been emitted to this original client.
    e=conn.Close();r.mu.Lock();r.failure=errors.Join(r.failure,e);r.mu.Unlock();close(r.loss);return
   }
  }
  if issue && response.StatusCode==http.StatusOK {
   r.mu.Lock();verify:=r.lost && !r.held && !r.replayed && id==r.originalID;old:=append([]byte{},r.lostRaw...);r.mu.Unlock()
   if verify {var v poolservice.IssueResponse;d:=json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body));d.DisallowUnknownFields();e:=d.Decode(&v);canonical,_:=json.Marshal(v)
    if e!=nil || !bytes.Equal(bytes.Trim(body," \t\r\n"),canonical) || !bytes.Equal(bytes.Trim(body," \t\r\n"),bytes.Trim(old," \t\r\n")) || poolservice.ValidateRecoverableIssueResponse(r.expected,id,v,false)!=nil {r.mu.Lock();r.failure=errors.Join(r.failure,errors.New("original replay changed"));r.mu.Unlock();http.Error(w,"replay",502);return}
    r.mu.Lock();r.replayed=true;r.mu.Unlock();r.replay<-v
   }
  }
  for key,values:=range response.Header {if key=="Connection" || key=="Transfer-Encoding" {continue};for _,v:=range values {w.Header().Add(key,v)}}
  w.WriteHeader(response.StatusCode);_,_=w.Write(body) // ordinary canceled downstream delivery is preserved by client unknown semantics
 })
 go func(){r.done<-r.server.Serve(r.listener)}();return r
}
func (r *issueTLSRelay) armLoss(id string) {r.mu.Lock();defer r.mu.Unlock();require(r.originalID==id && !r.lose && !r.lost,"one loss for original request");r.lose=true}
func (r *issueTLSRelay) releaseAfterJoin() {r.mu.Lock();defer r.mu.Unlock();require(r.lost && r.held,"original reply hold");r.held=false;close(r.release)}
func (r *issueTLSRelay) evidence() map[string]any {r.mu.Lock();defer r.mu.Unlock();return map[string]any{"request_id":r.originalID,"lost":r.lost,"held":r.held,"response_sha256":hx(digest(r.lostRaw)),"response":r.lostResult,"events":append([]issueWireEvent{},r.events...),"error":r.failure!=nil}}
func (r *issueTLSRelay) close() error {if r==nil{return nil};r.mu.Lock();r.closing=true;r.mu.Unlock();e:=r.server.Close();se:=<-r.done;r.active.Wait();r.client.CloseIdleConnections();if errors.Is(se,http.ErrServerClosed){se=nil};r.mu.Lock();e=errors.Join(e,se,r.failure);r.mu.Unlock();return e}
